name: Basic Form 1
source: Toni Kennerson, school sheet (Basic Form One.docx via /workspace/katas/basic-form-1.md)
senseiLine: Practice your kata with your instructor.

steps.text: Step forward w/RF, pivot on the balls of feet, face L w/RF in rear, LH downward block (protect (L) front leg), followed by RF step forward, RH straight forward punch

Raise RH fist (across body) to L ear, look over R shoulder then 180- degree turn w/RF leading (big special turn), end facing R w/RF forward, followed by RH downward block (over RL), then LF step forward then LF straightforward punch

Raise LH fist (across body) to R ear, while (short) stepping to rear w/RF into cat stance, step forward w/LF, LH downward block (over LL), then RF step forward RH straight forward punch, LF step forward LH straight forward punch, RF step forward RH straight forward punch (kiai)
With LF step (behind) 180-degrees now facing L w/LF forward, LH downward block, followed by step forward w/RF, RH straight forward punch
With RF step (behind) 180-degree now facing R w/RF forward, RH downward block, followed by step forward w/LF, LH straight forward punch

Raise LH fist (across body) to R ear while short stepping to rear w/RF into cat stance, followed by step forward w/LF, LH downward block, then RF step forward RH straight forward punch, LF step forward, LH straight forward punch, RF step forward, RH straight forward punch (kiai)
With LF step (behind) 180-degree end facing L, w/LF forward, LH downward block, step forward w/RF, RH straight forward punch
Step (behind) 180-degree w/RF end facing right w/RF forward, RH downward block, step forward LF, LH straight forward punch

finish: Bring LF 180 degrees into (front facing) ready stance, move to attention & bow out
